entries.note: The pinned tier reads which contracts the pinned schema accepts and skips with that reason when the project declares a newer one, so a consumer can land a contract-3 declaration before the pin carries contract 3 without a red test. The skip disappears by itself at the pin bump, which is the point: the test then starts validating against rEngine's own schema and reader with no edit.
